doubt.C368191: Cannot be judged on staging as written: the case needs a line whose labor was done by a staff member who has since been DELETED, and staging refuses to delete such a person. Exact answers on work order S2-36022 (labor by "ZZAUTOTEST Gone Tech 80348", clock stopped with "Timesheet clocked out"): delete staff -> 400 {"errors":[{"error":"Staff is being used elsewhere."}]}; deactivate -> 201; delete again -> 400 {"errors":[{"error":"Staff is being used elsewhere."}]}. A brand-new unused staff member deletes at once (200 {"data":{"staff_id":"9447754c-..."}}), so the delete itself works. The Labor row still reads "ZZAUTOTEST Gone Tech 80348" (the person still exists). The product does not let the case's state be made, so no workaround is built (a state the product refuses is not created). Decision for the QA lead: mark Blocked with this reason, or point to a staging record where a deleted person already has labor. The read-only check C368177-deleted-user in the sixth pass looks for such a record.
